import re

def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text).replace("--", "-")

def truncate(text, n):
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    return text[: n - 3] + "..."

# Test cases
print(slugify("Hello World"))  # hello-world
print(slugify("  a   b  "))     # a-b
print(slugify("C++ rocks!"))   # c-rocks (fixed!)
print(slugify("a,b.c"))        # a-b-c
print(truncate("abc", 5))      # abc
print(truncate("abcdefghij", 8))  # abcde...
